title: [CQ-M07g0] Read-only seat liveness projection
description:
Read-only daemon slice split out of CQ-M07g (task-9076afab319b4056989e370039efba3d) by architect-b520bc90 on 2026-11-01. That task's own instruction applies: "If today's daemon projections cannot prove 'seat gone', split out a read-only daemon slice rather than guess."

**Why today's projections cannot prove it:**
- **list_workers** shows registered workers only, and nothing about their attempts.
- **get_context servedContext** names a task's open attempt, but not which worker owns it.
- **An attempt can outlive its worker record.** moe.deregister_worker "close[s] every attempt of this worker still in the finalizing phase (keyed on the attempt, so it works even after the worker record was pruned)". So "no worker record" does not prove "no open attempt".

Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation, decision 1 (one VM per seat). Depends on CQ-M07d (task-b0485bb1) only because both add one registration to packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/index.ts.

Objective: one read-only MCP call answers whether a worker seat is gone: no worker record or DEAD, and no open execution attempt carries its workerId. CQ-M07g's seat-VM cleanup calls it over loopback /mcp (scripts/local-runner/vm-control.mjs mcpCaller) with no workerId.

Deliverable (packages/moe-daemon):
- **New tool `moe.get_seat_liveness { workerId }`.** It returns exactly `{ workerId, registered: boolean, status: <worker status> | null, openAttempts: <count> }`.
  - registered/status come from state.workers.
  - openAttempts counts the attempts in state.attempts whose workerId matches and whose phase is running, finalizing or reconciling (attemptStore OPEN_PHASES). Attempts whose worker record is gone count too.
- **attemptStore.ts.** It exports a small counting helper, so OPEN_PHASES stays private.
- **Read-only.** No state write, no touchWorker or lastActivityAt change, no activity record and no chat post. A missing, non-string, blank, over-long or control-character workerId is refused INVALID_INPUT.
- **Registration.** The tool goes in getTools(), with TOOL_AUDIENCE 'wrapper'. It is called by scripts, never shown to agent seats.

NOT in scope:
- the ledger and vm-control changes (CQ-M07g);
- provisioning (CQ-M07i);
- the MCP_SERVER.md section, deferred to the CQ-M07 docs sweep as CQ-M07d did. No test requires it.

Verification: in a git-archive snapshot with this task's files overlaid, under env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH: cd <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run src/tools/getSeatLiveness.test.ts src/tools/registry.test.ts src/state/attemptStore.test.ts
definitionOfDone: moe.get_seat_liveness returns registered false, status null and openAttempts 0 for an unknown worker, and registered true with the worker's status for a registered one (vitest).

openAttempts counts that worker's running, finalizing and reconciling attempts, ignores closed ones and other workers' attempts, and still counts an open attempt whose worker record was pruned (vitest).
The call writes nothing (no worker activity change, no activity record, no file change), and a malformed workerId is refused INVALID_INPUT (vitest).
The tool is registered (tools/registry.test.ts passes) with TOOL_AUDIENCE 'wrapper'.
The named vitest command passes in a git-archive snapshot.
taskRails: Read-only: the tool never mutates state, touches a worker or grants anything.

implementationPlan.description:
Counting helper, tool and registration.
(a) state/attemptStore.ts: export countOpenAttempts(state, workerId): number. It makes one pass over state.attempts.values(), counting attempts where attempt.workerId === workerId and OPEN_PHASES.has(attempt.phase); OPEN_PHASES stays private. Read-only: no write, no detached() copies needed. Doc comment: it counts attempts whose worker record is gone too, because moe.deregister_worker and the restart purge can leave a finalizing attempt behind its pruned worker.
(b) New tools/getSeatLiveness.ts exports getSeatLivenessTool(_state): ToolDefinition, following tools/listWorkers.ts.
  - Name 'moe.get_seat_liveness'.
  - inputSchema { type: 'object', properties: { workerId: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['workerId'], additionalProperties: false }.
  - Description: wrapper-only and read-only; answers whether a seat is gone (no worker record or DEAD, and no open attempt carrying its workerId); a match is never proof a process is alive.
  The handler reads `(args as { workerId?: unknown } | undefined)?.workerId`, so null or non-object args are refused too. readWorkerId:
  - non-string: invalidInput('workerId', ...);
  - more than 255 chars: refused BEFORE any trim or scan, an O(1) refusal under the state mutex, exactly as tools/claimNextTask.ts readIdentityField orders it;
  - blank after trim: refused;
  - hasControlChar (exported by state/candidateStore.ts): refused.
  255 matters: CQ-M07g's ledger caps workerId at 128, so every id it records is accepted here.
  Then `const worker = state.workers.get(workerId)` and return exactly { workerId, registered: worker !== undefined, status: worker?.status ?? null, openAttempts: countOpenAttempts(state, workerId) }. No state write, no touchWorker or lastActivityAt change, no activity record, no chat post and no emitter call. Not `blocking`: it is a fast read under the mutex McpAdapter already takes.
(c) tools/index.ts: import the factory, add it to getTools(), and add `'moe.get_seat_liveness': 'wrapper'` to TOOL_AUDIENCE. toolAudience.test.ts requires TOOL_AUDIENCE keys to equal the registered names exactly.
error handling: every refusal is a MoeError with codeName INVALID_INPUT; there is no other failure path, because state reads cannot throw.

Tests in new tools/getSeatLiveness.test.ts, using ToolTestHarness the way state/attemptStore.test.ts and tools/heartbeat.test.ts do: init, setupMoeFolder({ schemaVersion: 6 }), createEpic, createTask, createWorker, await state.load(), and cleanup in afterEach. Seed attempts with openAttempt(h.state, { taskId, workerId, runnerId, workspace }); openAttempt allows one open attempt per task and does not check the assignee. Use setAttemptPhase for the finalizing, reconciling and closed attempts. Call the tool through getSeatLivenessTool(h.state).handler(args, h.state). Cases:
1. DoD 1. An unknown id gives exactly toEqual({ workerId: 'worker-x', registered: false, status: null, openAttempts: 0 }). A registered IDLE worker gives { workerId, registered: true, status: 'IDLE', openAttempts: 0 }. A DEAD record gives registered true, status 'DEAD'.
2. DoD 2.
  - worker-1 holds running (task-1), finalizing (task-2), reconciling (task-3) and closed (task-4) attempts, and worker-2 holds a running attempt on task-5. worker-1 gives openAttempts 3 and worker-2 gives 1.
  - An attempt opened for 'worker-gone', which has no worker record (the post-prune shape), gives { registered: false, status: null, openAttempts: 1 }.
3. DoD 3, writes nothing. worker-1 has a fixed old lastActivityAt. Snapshot every file under h.moePath (relative path to sha256 of its bytes, walked recursively) plus structuredClone(h.state.workers.get('worker-1')). Call the tool for worker-1, worker-gone and an unknown id. Both snapshots must be unchanged, lastActivityAt included.
4. DoD 3, refusals. Each of these rejects with a MoeError whose codeName is INVALID_INPUT: no args, {}, { workerId: 42 }, '', '   ', a 256-char id, 'w\nx', 'w\u007fx'. A 255-char id is accepted.
5. DoD 4. getTools({} as StateManager) names include it; TOOL_AUDIENCE['moe.get_seat_liveness'] === 'wrapper'; toolsForRole(tools, role) excludes it for architect, worker, qa and governor.
Assert exact values, never mere truthiness, so a handler that does nothing fails.

Verification gate, run once (DoD 5). Run it in a git-archive snapshot outside the checkout: the shared checkout is the live runtime, so never npm ci, build or test there.
S=$(mktemp -d /tmp/m07g0-gate.XXXXXX) && git -C /mnt/d/projexts/moes archive HEAD packages/moe-daemon | tar -x -C "$S" && for f in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/attemptStore.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/index.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getSeatLiveness.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getSeatLiveness.test.ts; do cp "/mnt/d/projexts/moes/$f" "$S/$f"; done && cd "$S/packages/moe-daemon" && env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" sh -c 'umask 022 && npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run src/tools/getSeatLiveness.test.ts src/tools/registry.test.ts src/tools/toolAudience.test.ts src/state/attemptStore.test.ts'
It must exit 0. If the shared tools/index.ts carries a peer's uncommitted hunk that breaks the snapshot, overlay only your own hunks (git diff of that file applied in the snapshot) and say so in the evidence.
The fresh output is the complete_task verification evidence.

Adversarial self-review of this diff, as the final step (load adversarial-self-review). Check:
1. Can any code path in the handler write state, touch a worker, append activity or emit? Grep the new file for state method calls.
2. Does an over-long id get refused before any scan?
3. Do prototype-name ids such as 'constructor' and 'toString' answer registered false, with no throw? (Map lookups.)
4. Is a worker record present but DEAD reported as registered true with status 'DEAD', for the consumer to map?
5. Is the reply's key set exactly the four keys?
6. Is OPEN_PHASES still private?
7. Is the tool absent from every seat's tools/list?
If any byte changes, re-run step 3's exact command and submit that fresh output.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: A wrapper-only, read-only MCP tool moe.get_seat_liveness { workerId } returns exactly { workerId, registered, status, openAttempts }. openAttempts counts that worker's running, finalizing and reconciling attempts, including ones whose worker record was pruned. CQ-M07g's vm-control calls it over loopback /mcp to prove a seat gone.
invariants: The call never writes state, files, activity, chat or worker presence.
Malformed workerId is INVALID_INPUT; over-long is refused before any scan.
compatibility: No existing tool, wire shape or record changes; TOOL_AUDIENCE gains one 'wrapper' entry.
sourceAssumptions: McpAdapter tools/call never filters by TOOL_AUDIENCE and never touches workers generically (server/McpAdapter.ts tools/call branch).
attemptStore.ts OPEN_PHASES = running, finalizing, reconciling; openAttempt checks no assignee; setAttemptPhase only forbids leaving closed.
toolAudience.test.ts requires TOOL_AUDIENCE keys to equal registered tool names exactly; registry.test.ts requires every *Tool factory registered.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Extending list_workers, or get_context servedContext, was rejected. Neither can say whether an open attempt carries a pruned worker's id, and changing their shapes touches consumers. A dedicated wrapper tool is additive.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- invalidInput() carries codeName INVALID_INPUT.
- hasControlChar is exported from state/candidateStore.ts.
- ToolTestHarness provides createWorker/createTask; openAttempt allows one open attempt per task.
- No test requires an MCP_SERVER.md section; it is deferred to the CQ-M07 docs sweep.
planningNotes.risks:
- The consumer contract is fixed by CQ-M07g's plan (vm-control seatStateOf): reply keys and the 'DEAD' status spelling must match exactly.
- tools/index.ts is also edited by CQ-M07d, which is why this task dependsOn it.
